type.zh: 自有实践 · AI 工作系统

summary.zh: 把智能体、知识、工具与人的协作，组织成可调用的工作系统。
summary.en: Organising agents, knowledge, tools and people into a usable working system.

background.zh: 面向超级个体与企业，探索 AI 原生的服务与项目交付方式。
background.en: An ongoing practice in AI-native services and project delivery for independent professionals and businesses.

challenge.zh: 不同工具与能力需要围绕实际任务建立协作，而不只是分别演示。
challenge.en: Separate tools and capabilities need to cooperate around an actual task.

zh: 从客户场景与任务边界开始
组合智能体、知识与工具
在项目中组织人与 AI 协作
en: Start with the task and its boundaries
Organise human and AI collaboration in delivery

zh: 超级工作站交付方式介绍视频
大鲤鱼角色与品牌应用
服务与课程的展示入口
en: A video introducing the delivery model
A website connecting services and training

evidence.zh: 本页展示自有实践中的品牌素材与交付方式视频。
evidence.en: This page shows brand assets and the delivery-model video from our own practice.

name.zh: 高思控制 · 产品内容表达

type.zh: 工业技术 · 内容与影像

summary.zh: 把工业产品资料，梳理成脚本、分镜与可观看的产品短片。
summary.en: Turning technical product materials into scripts, storyboards and product films.

background.zh: 围绕工业热处理过程控制，整理专业技术的品牌语言与内容结构。
background.en: Communicating specialist knowledge in industrial heat-treatment process control.

challenge.zh: 既要讲清产品与使用场景，也需要对参数和技术表述逐项核对。
challenge.en: Communicate the product clearly while checking technical statements and specifications.

zh: 梳理产品资料与关键说法
组织脚本、分镜与影像表达
对成片与技术内容分别检查
en: Review product information and key statements
Develop scripts, storyboards and visual communication
Check the film and its technical claims

evidence.zh: 已有产品短片、脚本、分镜与检查记录。部分画面为资料示意渲染，技术表述需经客户审核。
evidence.en: The project has films, scripts, storyboards and review records. Some visuals are illustrative renders; technical statements require client review.

name.zh: 中域云仓 · 服务与品牌表达
name.en: Zhongyu Cloud · Service and Brand Communication

type.zh: 会展供应链 · 服务表达

summary.zh: 围绕会展道具租赁，梳理服务场景、品牌形象与跨城仓网表达。
summary.en: Making exhibition rental services, brand identity and a multi-city warehouse network easier to understand.

background.zh: 以会展道具租赁为业务基础，连接品牌表达与线下服务场景。
background.en: An exhibition-prop rental business connecting brand communication with offline service.

challenge.zh: 业务范围、服务资源与角色形象需要放在同一套表达中。
challenge.en: Bring service scope, resources and character identity into one coherent presentation.

zh: 探索仓小云角色与品牌物料
组织仓网和线下服务的信息表达
en: Explore the Cang Xiaoyun character and brand materials

zh: 品牌角色与形象应用探索

evidence.zh: 已提供的品牌标志、角色应用探索与服务场景构成这份项目展示的基础。
evidence.en: This project presentation draws on the supplied brand mark, character explorations and service scenarios.
